v: Typical Luv Ranjan madness 😄 First half takes its sweet time, but interval nunchi full fun... and that crazy climax made the whole thing work for me 🤣
e: Tu Jhoothi Main Makkaar follows Luv Ranjan’s familiar relationship-comedy template, but Ranbir Kapoor and Shraddha Kapoor bring fresh chemistry and the film finds its strongest rhythm after the interval. The crazy climax is exactly the kind of comic escape that makes the whole conflict work without over-explaining it.
body:
if you are a fan of Luv Ranjan’s format of films….then once again Tu Jhoothi Main Makkar is a must watch!!!!

it follows similar Luv Ranjan’s template and dialogue formats and man this movie though looks similar in bits and pieces to his previous films….has way more entertainment value 👌

Interval Block, Second Half & Crazy Climax are the super strength of this movie where as First Half though sets the tone could be made better…

Ranbir Kapoor & Shradha Kapoor have sizzling chemistry and have been a fresh pair on screen….and they both did a fantastic job 👌 but somewhere the die hard fan in me who enjoyed and loved the trio of Luv Ranjan, Karthik Aaryan & Nushrat was disappointed a bit as I thought they would have been perfect fit for this role….but the guest appearance of Karthik & Nushrat was a pleasant surprise 😊

All the supporting cast did a wonderful job and off-late Dimple Kapadia is getting some note worthy characters and she is killing it

Special mention to the crazy climax, I was wondering how the director would justify the conflict points between main chars as justifying one would show others in negative!!! but man the director choose to go for crazy climax which would be laugh riot and you will be never bothered about the justification 🤣

overall a Good Watch….

v: SRK comeback ante ila undali 😍 Swagger, action, Deepika, John, killer BGM... and when physics itself gives up, Salman Bhai Irukuuu!!! 🤣🔥
e: Pathaan worked for me as exactly the comeback vehicle Shah Rukh Khan needed: unapologetically large, stylish and crowd-pleasing. The film may not be technically flawless, but its cast, action, terrific BGM and Spy Universe ambition make those imperfections very easy to ignore.
body:
EXCELLENT TREAT!!!!! I am still awestruck and would definitely watching it multiple times 😍 we all know that Bollywood has been going through worst phase with all round attack from Boycott gangs supported with weak content and Box-office Hijacked with Hindi Dubbed movies, and when nothing is working for them it needed the KING to come back from 4 years of Exile and a helping hand from BHAI JAAN to literally drag Bollywood out of trouble 🙏🙏🙏🙏

It has Good Content supported by all the actors who did a fabulous job along with all the terrific stunts and looking hot at the same time 😍 Technically the film may not be perfect but it will ensure you don’t care about those….BGM is TERRIFIC and Yash Raj Banner is known for its high production values!!!

a perfect comeback movie by SRK which makes even normal audience go wow and his die hard fans can only scream scream and scream…..Deepika too did a terrific job with her Stunts and Glamour!!! Same goes with John Abraham!!! overall just like how Iron Man has set up the future of Avengers…..Pathaan has nicely setup the Spy Verse for Indian Cinema 👌👌👌

v: Poonakalu raaledhu... kaani time-pass ayipoyindi 😄 Routine story and weak climax, but vintage Chiru comedy + dialect + dances gave me enough to enjoy once.
e: Waltair Veerayya is formula cinema with limited story impact, but Bobby understands the nostalgic Chiranjeevi flavour his audience wants. The Srikakulam dialect, comedy timing and dance staging bring flashes of vintage Chiru even though the Ravi Teja track and climax never deliver the expected high.
body:
Poonakalu raledhu gaani Time pass ayyipoyindi…..Bobby who is self proclaimed fan of Chiru, has made sure to present him in the massy avatar which has made him the Mega Star….but lack of impactful content and Chiru’s looks in few scenes (which somehow lost the grace) are the drawbacks

Though the content is ordinary and screenplay is commercial formula based, but its been ages last time Chiru has done such character and thats what make this film bearable for normal audience and bring back vintage feeling for his fans….Personally I got the vibes of Annaya, Shankar Dada and Andhariwadu vibes looking at the massy look, Srikakulam dialect and Comedy timing….which proves a point that though Chiru may have lost his charm in looks but his comedy timing is still intact and if any director wants to make an out and out comedy entertainer with him he still can do wonders 🙏 especially the way he sings Jambulakadi Jaru Mitaya song is 👌👌👌

Songs and BGM are pretty ordinary and doesnt have any impact….but the dances again are choreographed to give those vintage Chiru feel and thats worked well….

Unfortunately the much hyped Poonakalu in 2nd Half with Ravi Teja is missing as I expected much more impact other than a normal back story….Pre Climax and Climax episodes though Bobby tried to do something different didn’t gel well!!!!

overall its one time watch with routine direction and not so great content but definitely a far better movie for Chiru post comeback!!!!!

v: Balayya elevations plenty... fresh content very little 🙏 Hardcore fans may enjoy, but for me this is nowhere near Simha, Legend or Akhanda.
e: Veera Simha Reddy is designed almost entirely as Balakrishna fan-service. Gopichand Malineni lands a few elevations and political punches, but the familiar dual-role structure, repetitive fights and underwhelming music leave the film without the content needed to make those highs memorable.
body:
once again proved….except Boyapati!!! No one can give a High Elevations to Balaya along with kickass content…..Gopichand a self proclaimed fan of Bala Krishna got some good elevations and few political punches which will excite hardcore fans but failed to provide proper content to support those elevations

Coming to the content it follows the same template of Balaya’s enormous past movies which has him playing dual role with the so called younger role being a dummy and the senior being the most powerful 🙏 and a back story to support his cause…though Gopichand tried Sister Sentiment it reminded me of Chanakesava Reddy with a twist!!!

Except for the oora mass faction style fight in Istanbul nothing else was new….though the movie had around 7 fights, almost all the fight styles are same with just a change in the fighters and background 🙏

Thaman’s music which was a huge asset for films like Akhanda and others didn’t gel well with whats happening in the movie….

well the intention of Gopichand is clearly to serve the hardcore fan base of his fans and its clearly evident the way that the main song of the film which is written to praise the key character of the film has the name “Jai Balaya” where none of the characters name is Balaya or Balakrishna 🤣

Ultimate Content like Akhanda and Talk Show like Unstoppable has brought back the craze of Balakrishna, but him going back to choose subjects like this would impact his new found craze among the youth and family audience 😞

Movie may be an average Hit due to its commercial format or Festival season….but definitely will not create an impact which the movies like Simha, Legend or Akhanda have created!!!
